_comment: Documented, time-bounded conformance exceptions (TASK-560). An entry here does NOT weaken the gate: conformance_gate.py still FAILS on any non-conformer that is not listed, on a listed category whose hard_failures differ from those recorded, and on a listed category that now conforms (a stale entry must be deleted, so an exception can never become a permanent silent bypass). Every entry needs an owning task. This mirrors the shadow/gold gates' protective mode: block on regression, never on a documented standing state. HISTORY: bread exception (TASK-561, HARD-3-baseline_served) removed 2026-07-10 after the v3->v4 baseline cutover landed — bread conforms again.
